the importance of TIMP-2 in the pathogenesis of LV hypertrophy and remodeling in patients with paroxysm atrial fibrillation.
a possible role of MMPs and TIMPs in pathogenesis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and LV hypertrophy in patients with AH.
the role of TIMP- 1 in the process of development of LV remodeling in patients with AH and paroxysm atrial fibrillation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the increase of MMP-1 and decrease of TIMP- 1 levels in the serum of patients with AH and paroxysms of atrial fibrilation are associated with the increase of LVMM and the development of concentric LV hypertrophy.
the MMP-1/TIMP-1 ratio is not only an index of myocardial collagen turnover, but also a predictor of the progression and prognosis of LV remodeling in patients with AH.
the serum concentrations of TIM-1 and MMP-1 are not associated with the degree of diastolic and systolic dysfunction, but with prognostically unfavourable types of LV remodelling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the increase of TIMP- 1 level is a marker of LV remodeling in patients with AH and paroxysm atrial fibrillation.
in patients with AH increase in serum concentrations of TIM-1 was associated both with increase in thickness of interventrikulalr septum and with prognosticly unfavorable types of LV-remodeling.
MMP-1 and its tissue inhibitors TIMP-1 are associated with the development of myocardial fibrogenesis in patients with arterial hypertensin and paroxysms of atrial fibrillations.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the increase of TIMP- 1 level is associated with increased thickness interventricular septal, increased LVMMI, increase of peak velocity of late diastolic filling of the right atrium, and with unfavorable types of LV hypertrophy.

in the group of patients suffering from arterial hypertension, the increase of serum concentrations TIMP-1 is associated with increased thickness interventricular septa, increase of the left ventricular myocardium mass, and prognostically unfavorable type of the left ventricle remodeling.

in patients with arterial hyperten-sion with paroxysm of atrial fibrillations, increase in TIMP-1 serum concentrations is associated with increased thickness interventricular septums, increase of LVMI and prognostically unfavorable forms of LV remodelling.
